description: CarePoint — near-white, blue-rationed clinic booking derived from reference R15 (Medica). This family is the reason the family-config layer exists: Mission 018's run inherited a warm blush hairline, a Playfair serif and a white ground from the butcher compiler, and the template worked around all three with hardcoded hexes. Those decisions are now declared here.

typography.displayRoleNote: The R15 reference is sans-led at every level: hierarchy comes from weight and size, not from a display face. displayStrategy 'sans' resolves the display role to the UI stack, which is what the reference actually does.

responsive.mobile: Single column. Doctor list is a stacked row list. Slot grid 4-up. Fixed bottom tab bar (Home / Appointments).
responsive.desktop: Doctor list becomes a 2-column grid. Tab bar hidden; bottom padding reserved for it is dropped.
